Constitution of Kenya, 2010                                    167


       263. This Constitution shall come into force on its promulgation Effective Date.
by the President or on the expiry of a period of fourteen days from the
date of the publication in the Gazette of the final result of the referendum
ratifying this Constitution, whichever is the earlier.

      264. The Constitution in force immediately before the effective Repeal of previous
date shall stand repealed on the effective date, subject to the Sixth constitution.

      SECOND SCHEDULE                                         (Article 9 (2))

                            NATIONAL SYMBOLS

        (a) The National Flag




      Note–– All dimensions given do not necessarily represent any particular
             measurement and are merely proportional.

      Description––

      Three major strips of equal width coloured from top to bottom black,
      red and green and separated by narrow white strips, with a symmetrical
      shield and white spears superimposed centrally.
